products.name: Samsung Galaxy A06
products.description: The Samsung Galaxy A06 is a powerful smartphone designed for those who demand performance and versatility. Featuring a generous 6.7-inch TFT U-Cut display, this device offers a vibrant viewing experience with a resolution of 720 x 1600 (HD+). Equipped with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of internal storage, expandable via microSD up to 1TB, it ensures ample space for your apps and media. The dual SIM capability allows for seamless connectivity across 2G, 3G, and 4G networks, complemented by Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac for fast internet access.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A07 4G
products.description: The Galaxy A07 features a 6.7-inch PLS LCD display with a resolution of 720 x 1600 pixels (HD+), offering good visibility and vibrant colors for everyday media consumption. The phone has a simple design with a glass front, plastic back, and a plastic frame, available in basic colors like Black, Light Blue, and Silver. While not a high-resolution panel, its large screen size makes it suitable for streaming videos and social media.

products.name: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max
products.description: The iPhone 17 Pro Max combines cutting-edge mobile technology with an elegant, refined aesthetic. Featuring a brilliant Super Retina XDR display with vibrant color precision, it delivers stunning visuals, deep blacks, and remarkable peak brightness. Powered by Apple's ultra-fast Advanced Apple A-series Bionic processor for high performance, this smartphone handles intensive multitasking, high-end gaming, and complex Apple Intelligence workflows effortlessly. Equipped with high-speed internal storage, providing ample room for 4K video, photos, apps, and media files.
